# Daugavan
> Personal site of Marcus ("Daugavan") — a Swedish builder of small, honest tools.
> Primary project: PromptFlower (prompt.studio / superprompts). Background in
> agent design, web frontend, and local-first AI tooling. Lives on a small
> island of public repositories at github.com/Daugavan.

The site is a single page that pulls cached public GitHub repository data (repos, stars, commits) from `https://api.github.com`. There is no backend, no build step,
and no analytics. The page is hand-crafted HTML + CSS + vanilla JS.

## Pages
- [Home](https://daugavan.github.io/): profile, live stats, top repositories,
  PromptFlower showcase, and a small interactive console.
- [404](https://daugavan.github.io/404.html): on-brand not-found page.

## Projects
- [PromptFlower](https://promptflower.app/): private prompt studio.
  Turns rough ideas into copy-ready superprompts. Local-first, Ollama-ready.

## Profiles
- GitHub: https://github.com/Daugavan
- Lovable: https://lovable.dev/@daugavan
- PromptFlower: https://promptflower.app/

## Optional
- [Sitemap](https://daugavan.github.io/sitemap.xml)
- [robots.txt](https://daugavan.github.io/robots.txt)

Repository data is cached for 30 minutes; commit search counts for six hours. Unknown or incomplete counts are explicitly identified.
